checks: Eight authored maps have35 connected rooms, unique entities, valid floor placements and nonoverlapping ports
Ready state rejects actions and start advances no beat or resource
Unknown commands, invalid/prototype directions and stale revisions cannot mutate a run
Walls and closed boundaries block position; attempted movement still spends a visible beat
Dodge walks at most two valid cells and cannot cross walls or room doors
Sweep hits only one-cell visible arc, respects diagonal wall corners and has two other-beat cooldown
Enemy occupancy prevents movement overlap throughout every normal campaign
Moss strikes use two-beat locked telegraphs, not immediate contact damage
Moving out of a locked telegraph avoids that actual strike without health writes
Damage grants cooldown so an immediate next beat cannot damage again
A real injury permits one finite potion, heals actual missing health and full health rejects use
Two used potions cannot be duplicated; empty supply refuses healing even while hurt
Natural standing-in-danger death settles once and cannot heal or act after death
Key pickup IDs are unique and opening a key door consumes exactly one permanently
Closed key/lamp/clear doors explain their unmet condition without spending a beat
A live combat seal refuses interaction before its actual room is cleared
A lamp gate refuses interaction while the required remote lamp is unlit
Room crossings use the paired inward spawn and skip enemy advancement on arrival
Revisiting a cleared room preserves defeated IDs and does not respawn enemies or items
Lamp activation and clear-door opening occur through normal interactions only once
The final key gate requires the north lamp before spending the first key
Eye beams stop at walls and armor tenable diagonal gaps never include diagonal intent cells
Hazards expose safe/warning/active phases on the shared six-beat cycle
No victory before every lamp and exit interaction; completed campaigns settle only once
Pause blocks all enemy, hazard, resource and position changes; resume preserves exact model
Running checkpoints reproduce every enemy intent, cooldown, door and item before resuming paused
Illegal resume logs are rejected and forged health/keys/room fields are ignored
Diagnostics snapshots and checkpoint commands are detached from all live mutable state
Every ordinary campaign conserves all health, keys, finite pickups, enemies and room transitions
fixture: All health, inventory, room, key, injury, recovery, death and victory checks use formal levels and ordinary actions. No live-resource or result fixtures.
